name: HGH Fragment 17-23
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: HGH Fragment 17-23 (F17) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is HGH Fragment 17-23 tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each F17 lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 221231-10-3, formula C78H125N23O23S2, 1817.10 Da).

faq.question: How should HGH Fragment 17-23 be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for HGH Fragment 17-23: store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the F17 lot certificate.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for HGH Fragment 17-23?
faq.answer: HGH Fragment 17-23 is stocked in 1 pack size (10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $78.00; 10–49 kits falls to $71.76 (−8%) and 50+ to $66.30 (−15%).
